ci.name: Node (lint, types, fast unit tests, build, size)

gate.name: Full gate (check, ingest, e2e) on PR head merged with main

prepare.name: Merge the pull request's head into main (what the pull_request event tests)

browsers.name: Playwright's Chromium
browsers.run:
if sudo -n true 2>/dev/null; then npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
else npx playwright install chromium
fi
